call_trace_wrapped: call trace_wrapped with a single tensor argument and a function fn to defer complex backward hooks to compiled autograd
create_HigherOrderOperator_trace_wrapped: create a HigherOrderOperator named trace_wrapped for proxy tensor tracing without inlining into fn
invoke_inner_trace: invoke inner_trace under ProxyTorchDispatchMode to insert trace_wrapped as a call_function in the traced graph
use_trace_wrapped_functionalized: use _trace_wrapped_functionalized to unwrap and redispatch tensors through the next dispatch key
assert_trace_wrapped_meta: assert trace_wrapped output metadata matches input size stride and dtype via _assert_meta
